name: Dash
what_it_does: Burst of speed in the direction you are already moving. Blocked on rail, drop stall, 0 RPM, or while another ability holds you.

name: Dash
what_it_does: How hard the dash shoves you. Clash knock cap is 0.086 so this is a strong shove but under a full clash.

name: Dash
what_it_does: Player-only chance the existing inner-lens slo-mo cam runs for the dash. CPU dashes never roll this.
notes: Reuse kill cam. Do not add a second camera.

name: Dash
what_it_does: How long a dash slo-mo holds.
notes: 1.5s. Physics ticks stay 1/60; only the clock feeding them slows.

name: All actives
what_it_does: Uses per match for every ACTIVE kit. Passives do not spend this.
notes: Both you and CPU get this many.

name: Simul press
what_it_does: If both press an active within this window, one is DENIED at random.

name: Clash knock cap
what_it_does: Hard cap on any ability shove.
notes: Do not raise for a single kit without talking physics.

name: Ancient Sword
what_it_does: Dran Sword, Viper Tail, Shark Edge, Shark Scale. 2 uses. If foe is inside range, both freeze 3s. 4 cuts every 0.6s, each 1–3 RPM (4–12 total), then a stronger shove. Miss still spends a use.
notes: Bigger = easier to land. Stadium radius is about 1.

name: Ancient Sword
what_it_does: How long the freeze/cut lasts if it hits.

name: Ancient Sword
what_it_does: Seconds between cuts. 4 cuts max.

name: Ancient Sword
what_it_does: RPM taken per cut (random in this range). HUD RPM = this × 100.
notes: Shows as 1–3 RPM on the bar.

name: Ancient Sword
what_it_does: End shove uses average of 0.48–0.64 × knock cap. You get 40% of that shove back.

name: Hurricane
what_it_does: Arrow Wizard, Leon Claw, Wizard Rod, Shelter Drake. 2 uses. 3s. +12% move speed. Restore 10 RPM over 3s. First time foe enters the wind: shove 0.042. Staying in adds a light push.

name: Hurricane
what_it_does: Wind radius (−15% from 0.84).

name: Hurricane
what_it_does: Move speed while up. 1.00 = normal.

name: Hurricane
what_it_does: Fixed RPM restored over the 3s. HUD shows +10.
notes: 10 on the bar. Not a percent of current RPM.

name: Hurricane
what_it_does: First-enter shove.

name: Iron Skin
what_it_does: Leon Crest, Knight Mail, Knight Shield. 2 uses. 3s chrome. Clash RPM on you = 0. Their knock cancelled. You shove them at 120% of that knock, still capped. Idle drain and holes still kill.

name: Iron Skin
what_it_does: Reflect multiplier on their knock.

name: Free Spin
what_it_does: Silver Wolf. Always on. Each clash: this chance you take 0 RPM from that hit and 35% less knock.

name: Free Spin
what_it_does: Knock you take when it procs, as a fraction of normal.

name: Double Edge
what_it_does: Unicorn Sting. Always on. Each clash 1/3 +28% your knock and 1–4 extra RPM on them (+KB), 1/3 −18% your knock (−KB), 1/3 nothing.

name: Double Edge
what_it_does: +KB multiplier on your knock.

name: Double Edge
what_it_does: +KB extra RPM on the opponent.

name: Double Edge
what_it_does: −KB multiplier on your knock.

name: Earthquake
what_it_does: Tyranno Beat. 2 uses. 3s. Up to 7 cracks. Each lives ~0.42–0.80s. Only a Bey that hits a live crack takes 1–3 RPM, 82% of slide dumped, shove 0.032.

name: Earthquake
what_it_does: How far cracks can spawn from you.

name: Earthquake
what_it_does: Max cracks at once.

name: Earthquake
what_it_does: RPM chip per crack hit.

name: Earthquake
what_it_does: Slide left after a crack hit.

name: Earthquake
what_it_does: Outward shove on a crack hit.

name: Pegasus Blast
what_it_does: Aero Pegasus. 2 uses. 1.3s lift (you vanish), then 3s aim, then crash. Hit if the glow marker disc (SVG r=13.2 → world 13.2/39) overlaps their Bey disc even a graze. Hit RPM = 8 + 10% of their remaining RPM (8 empty / 18 full) and 70%-cap shove. Miss: you lose 15 RPM.

name: Pegasus Blast
what_it_does: Aim window after lift.

name: Pegasus Blast
what_it_does: Hit RPM = this + 0.10 × foe remaining RPM.

name: Pegasus Blast
what_it_does: Extra hit RPM as a fraction of foe remaining RPM.

name: Pegasus Blast
what_it_does: Miss cost on you.

name: Pegasus Blast
what_it_does: CPU marker starts on a miss offset 0.32–0.60 from the live player (not a far random spawn). Lift tracks that offset. Aim follows it at ~8–16%/frame — hits some blasts

name: Flame Trail
what_it_does: Phoenix Wing. 2 uses. 2.3s. +15% move. Fire lasts 0.9s behind you. Own trail does not burn you. If they drive through: 0.8 RPM every 0.3s, then after 1s 1.6–2.4 RPM every 0.5s.

name: Flame Trail
what_it_does: When burn ticks get worse.

name: Flame Trail
what_it_does: How long each fire point lives.

name: Flame Trail
what_it_does: Move speed while trailing.

name: Flame Trail
what_it_does: Phase 1 burn per tick.

name: Flame Trail
what_it_does: Phase 2 burn per tick.

name: +2 to a stat
what_it_does: Hub common. 34% type-lean, 33% patch lowest, 33% random. Always +2 to one of ATK KB DEF MOB BAL STA. No downside.

name: Tradeoff A
what_it_does: 62% type-lean, else random. 42% of uncommons are +4 / −2.

name: Tradeoff B
what_it_does: The other 58% of uncommons.

name: Ability swap
what_it_does: 16% of rares. Two random kits from the pool. BACK keeps the current kit.

name: Reforge
what_it_does: 42% of rares. Pick a new bit or a new ratchet from 3 offers. Physics change with the part.

name: Peak +4
what_it_does: 21% of rares. +4 to type or your peak stat. No catch.

name: Pair +2 +2
what_it_does: 21% of rares. +2 type and +2 another line.

name: Rogue modifier
what_it_does: Replaces your current modifier. See MODIFIER sheet.

name: Evolve form
what_it_does: Silver/Gold step form (Bronze→Silver→Gold). Shop bonuses stay. Bronze-form pull-down eases.

name: Enhanced tier
what_it_does: One and done. +4 on your best 3 stats, +3 on the rest. Later positive upgrades get +1 extra. Honeycomb plate.

name: Enhanced rest
what_it_does: The other 3 stats on enhance.

name: Later extra
what_it_does: After enhance, every later +stat also gets this extra.

name: Form pity
what_it_does: If no form card for 4 hubs, last offer becomes evolve/enhance. Always injects on mini bosses 6 and 12.

name: Rarity weights
what_it_does: Base roll: common 62, uncommon 24, rare 9, legendary 4, evolve 1. Bronze shop kinder, Gold thinner.

name: LAST STAND
what_it_does: Under 40% RPM: +8 DEF +5 KB. Healthy: −3 MOB.

name: LAST STAND
what_it_does: Low-RPM bonuses.

name: BERSERKER
what_it_does: Above 70% RPM: +7 ATK +5 KB. Below 35% RPM: −6 DEF.

name: RAIL RUSH
what_it_does: While riding X-Rail or just after X-Exit: +8 ATK.

name: FINAL SPIN
what_it_does: Under 28% RPM: +10 STA. Above 62% RPM: −3 ATK.

name: HEAVY CONTACT
what_it_does: After a heavy hit, next clash +7 KB −4 MOB.

name: COUNTERWEIGHT
what_it_does: After taking real knock, next hit +8 KB.

name: PIN LOCK
what_it_does: Inside radius 0.42: +6 BAL +4 DEF. Wider than 0.72: −3 ATK.

name: X-EXIT SWING
what_it_does: Fresh X-Exit (1s): +6 KB.

name: ENDURANCE
what_it_does: First 8s: −4 ATK. After: +8 STA +3 DEF.

name: GLASS CANNON
what_it_does: Always +9 ATK +6 KB. −8 DEF −5 BAL.

name: ANCHOR
what_it_does: Always +7 DEF +5 STA −5 MOB.

name: FIRST BLOOD
what_it_does: First 5s: +8 KB +4 ATK. Then gone.

name: LATE BLOOM
what_it_does: Before 10s: −2 MOB. After 10s: +6 ATK +4 BAL.

name: PSYSHOCK
what_it_does: First 5s: +5 KB. Clash knock cycles 60% now, store 40%, dump on next clash, reset.
